title: EQDS Research Data${suffix}
description: Reference, market and external-manager data for the EQDS research agents. SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA in the demo environment. Trades, positions and GIC research views live in the external OMS database and are NOT available here.

tables.name: ref_companies
tables.description: Company master: id, ticker, name, GICS sector and industry, country, region, MSCI EM membership, currency, market cap (USD).

tables.name: ref_holdings
tables.description: GIC fund holdings snapshot by fund (NGC85, NGC2383): weight and rank.

tables.name: efm_managers
tables.description: External fund managers with a quality score and whether they are in the better half.

tables.name: efm_holdings
tables.description: External manager holdings by month-end (shares, value in USD).

tables.name: efm_buy_basket
tables.description: External-manager buy basket by month-end: score (0-3 consecutive month-ends bought by better-half managers), buyers, net buying in USD, in_top50 flag.

tables.name: em_quant_scores
tables.description: EM quant score and quintile per month-end. Covers MSCI EM names only; quintile 1 is best, 5 is worst.

tables.name: prices_daily
tables.description: Daily close and 1-day return per company.

tables.name: earnings_calendar
tables.description: Earnings events per company: fiscal period, event type, date, status (reported, scheduled).

tables.name: geo_revenue
tables.description: Revenue by region and fiscal year with share of total (shares sum to 100% per company-year).

instructions: Join tables on company_id. Use ref_companies for names, sectors and countries.
The latest quant and basket month-end is 2026-10-31. Quant scores exist only for MSCI EM companies (msci_em = true); Japan names have none.
Do not answer questions about GIC trades, positions or analyst views: that data is outside this space.
All figures are USD unless a column name says otherwise. State the as-of date used.
sample_questions: Which companies are in the external-manager top-50 basket with score 3?
What is the quant quintile of each score-3 name at the latest month-end?
How did the top 10 names by net manager buying perform over the last month?
What is Weichai Power A's revenue share by region for each fiscal year?
Which companies report results in the next two weeks?

example_sqls.question: Score-3 names in the top-50 basket
example_sqls.sql: SELECT c.name, b.score, b.buyers, b.net_buy_usd FROM ${uc}.efm_buy_basket b JOIN ${uc}.ref_companies c USING (company_id) WHERE b.in_top50 AND b.score = 3 ORDER BY b.net_buy_usd DESC
